messages:
alyssa: quick heads-up, uploaded a short Q4 recurring-incident synthesis + proposed action items. want to lock owners and rough ETA this week. link: https://redwood.internal/doc/q4-recurring-summary :spiral_calendar:

lina: skimmed it. top recurring themes look like (1) cache thrash on hot models, (2) retry storms from flaky clients, (3) noisy alerts from transient infra. happy to own coordination if needed.

sanjay: i'll take cache thrash (model shard eviction). plan: spike to validate KV prewarm + adaptive cache sizing. propose timeline: spike by Thu, PR in 3w.

marie: i'll pair on retry storms. agree client SDK defaults need a look. will schedule a sync with SDK folks tomorrow.

jasper: taking noisy alerts. will run an alert-rule audit and a small playbook to suppress duplicates. target: audit complete in 1 week.

carl: FYI i can help with infra-side mitigations for cache thrash if sanjay wants collab (e.g., node-level eviction thresholds).

alyssa: great. two asks: 1) please add a single JIRA epic per theme and paste the link in the sheet column 'Epic' 2) fill the 'est_cust_hrs' column with your best guess so we can prioritize.

incident-bot: Catalog snapshot created: recurring-summary-2023-Q4-1805567890 (15 incidents). https://redwood.internal/incidents/catalog/1805567890

marie: question  we do server-side circuit breakers + SDK backoff change, what's the rollout plan? can we do server-side rollout first and follow with SDK defaults later?

sanjay: +1 server-side first. lower blast radius. can pair on a canary config for circuit breaker thresholds.

lina: timeline note: some of these incidents coincided with big model deployments last month. recommend we add a 'deploy correlation' column in the sheet.

alyssa: added 'deploy_corr' column now. please annotate if your theme shows correlation. also i'm going to seed epics for any theme without an owner today.

jasper: small operational note: when auditing alerts, i'll export current pager rules and run a diff vs. best-practice template. snippet I plan to use:
```
# fetch current rules
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://ops.redwood/api/alerts > alerts.json
# run local rule lint
./tools/alert-lint alerts.json
```
will paste results.

carl: filed epic RW-INC-9001 for cache-thrash mitigations and linked sheet.

marie: filed RW-INC-9002 for retry storms (me + sdk), target canary 2023-11-12. added est_cust_hrs ~ 14.

sanjay: filed RW-INC-9003 for cache prewarm spike. est_cust_hrs ~ 20.

alyssa: summary of commitments from this thread:
- cache thrash: owner sanjay (with carl), spike Thu, epic RW-INC-9003
- retry storms: owner marie (+sdk), canary 2023-11-12, epic RW-INC-9002
- noisy alerts: owner jasper, audit in 1 week, will propose suppression rules, epic TBD
- lina to coordinate cross-team deploy correlation analysis

alyssa: i'll follow up with a weekly 20-min sync starting next Wed to keep the tracker moving. please ping me if timelines slip. :raised_hands:
